rejects.event: The settlement grew into a city after Kamehameha I chose it.
rejects.quote: The settlement grew from a handful of homes to a city in the early 19th century after Kamehameha I chose it as a replacement for his residence at Waikiki in 1810.
rejects.why: The claim states the city grew in 1810, but the quote says it grew in the early 19th century and the residence was chosen in 1810.
